CASE-VISIBLE Ordinary dark text on the white page.

CASE-SAME-COLOUR White text on the white page.

CASE-NEAR-WHITE Very light grey text on the white page.

CASE-FAINT Light grey text, hard to read but there.

CASE-LIGHT Pale grey text, 1.36 to 1 against white.

CASE-FLAT-GRADIENT Text on a gradient of its own colour.

CASE-MANY-COLOURS White text on a white to black gradient.

CASE-OVER-PICTURE White text over a picture.

CASE-SHADOW White text with a dark shadow.

CASE-TRANSPARENT Text with no colour at all.

CASE-WASH Black text at three percent.

CASE-DARK White text on a black panel.

CASE-PANEL White text on a white panel over a gradient.
